sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The conditional logic still contains an accidental pass path: the first sh:or branch accepts a ship without validating the required power quantities or the inclusive comparison. Remove that bypass and require the applicable 1985 edition, ice class IB or IC, exactly one maximumContinuousRatingPower and exactly one requiredPowerUnder1985Rules quantity, each with decimal qudt:numericValue and qudt:KiloW, plus maximumContinuousRatingPower >= requiredPowerUnder1985Rules. Preserve ship targeting and the supplied canonical terms; no vocabulary matcher is needed.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the direct-static constraint so malformed alternative quantity values cannot be bypassed by a separate valid pair. The current FILTER NOT EXISTS only requires one mcr/required-power pair with decimal numericValue and kW unit; extra quantity values with missing or non-kW units, missing numericValue, or non-decimal numericValue may therefore pass. Constrain every value of maximumContinuousRatingPower and requiredPowerUnder1985Rules (preferably exactly one value each if uniqueness is required) to have a decimal qudt:numericValue and qudt:KiloW unit, while retaining applicability to ships whose applicableIceClassRegulationEdition is iceClassRuleEdition1985, iceClass IB or IC selection, and the inclusive minimum comparison mcrValue >= requiredValue.

Repair the direct-static constraint as previously instructed: ensure every value of maximumContinuousRatingPower and requiredPowerUnder1985Rules is exactly one valid quantity with decimal qudt:numericValue and qudt:KiloW unit, so malformed extra quantity values cannot be bypassed by a separate valid pair. Retain ship targeting, applicability to applicableIceClassRegulationEdition iceClassRuleEdition1985 with iceClass IB or IC, and the inclusive comparison maximumContinuousRatingPower >= requiredPowerUnder1985Rules.

Repair the conditional logic: the first sh:or branch currently passes any applicable IB/IC ship without checking either power quantity or the inclusive comparison, creating an accidental pass path. Remove that bypass and require the same applicability together with exactly one maximumContinuousRatingPower and exactly one requiredPowerUnder1985Rules value, each having decimal qudt:numericValue and qudt:KiloW, with maximumContinuousRatingPower >= requiredPowerUnder1985Rules. Preserve ship targeting and the supplied canonical terms; no vocabulary matcher is needed.

The conditional logic still contains an accidental pass path: the first sh:or branch accepts a ship without validating the required power quantities or the inclusive comparison. Remove that bypass and require the applicable 1985 edition, ice class IB or IC, exactly one maximumContinuousRatingPower and exactly one requiredPowerUnder1985Rules quantity, each with decimal qudt:numericValue and qudt:KiloW, plus maximumContinuousRatingPower >= requiredPowerUnder1985Rules. Preserve ship targeting and the supplied canonical terms; no vocabulary matcher is needed.
